# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old  <sub>[v2 c17 P73](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0073), [v3 c22 P3](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c40 P13](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0013)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea / Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031), [v2 c17 P73](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0073)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and farmer at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Cuthbert  <sub>[v1 c6 P5](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0005), [v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin, gaunt woman with sharp angles and no curves. Her dark hair shows gray streaks and is typically twisted up behind in a hard knot with two wire hairpins. Over time, her face has grown softer, though later in life she looks old, worn, and tired.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v3 c40 P13](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0013)_

## Personality

Marilla is a sensible, practical, and stoic woman of narrow experience, rigid conscience, and dry humor. Though strict, repressed, and reluctant to display deep emotion or affection openly, she possesses a tender heart that softens significantly through caring for children. She is prone to occasional headaches and can be sarcastic, brusque, or pessimistic when feeling self-conscious about her own feelings.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c26 P1](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0001), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v2 c19 P64](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0064), [v3 c7 P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016), [v3 c7 P17](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0017), [v3 c13 P0](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0000)_

## Goals

- To raise and train Anne into a useful and well-behaved young woman  <sub>[v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003)</sub>
- To provide proper training and a good home for the orphaned twins, Davy and Dora  <sub>[v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001)</sub>

## History

Marilla Cuthbert lived a quiet, cramped life at Green Gables in Avonlea with her brother Matthew. In middle age, they decided to adopt an orphan boy to help on the farm, but due to a mistake, Anne Shirley was brought to them instead; despite initial hesitation, Marilla chose to keep and raise Anne. Over the years, Marilla strictly supervised Anne's upbringing and domestic training while growing deeply attached to her in secret. Following Matthew's death and her own failing eyesight, Marilla took in her orphaned distant relatives, the twins Davy and Dora Keith, taking charge of their discipline and welfare. As Anne grew into womanhood and went off to college, Marilla continued to manage Green Gables with the assistance of Mrs. Rachel Lynde, remaining devotedly attached to Anne.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c16 P27](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0027), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c37 P28](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0028), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v3 c3 P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 c5 P8](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0008), [v3 c22 P3](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0003)_

## Background by volume

- Suffered sensitivities in childhood for being a dark, homely little girl  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- Inherited a treasured amethyst brooch containing her mother's hair  <sub>[v1 c13 P20](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0020)</sub>
- Quarreled with John Blythe in her youth and refused to forgive him, a regret she carried into later life  <sub>[v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)</sub>
- Lived at Green Gables for sixty years alongside her brother Matthew  <sub>[v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), [v2 c17 P73](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0073)</sub>
- Maintained a forty-five-year neighborly friendship with Rachel Lynde without a single quarrel  <sub>[v2 c26 P17](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0017)</sub>

## Quotes

> Unromantic fiddlesticks! Anne is a real good plain sensible name. You’ve no need to be ashamed of it.  <sub>[v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020)</sub>

> Matthew Cuthbert, you don’t mean to say you think we ought to keep her!  <sub>[v1 c3 P56](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0056)</sub>

> I’m not feeling discouraged, when I make up my mind to do a thing it stays made up. I suppose you’d like to see Anne. I’ll call her in.  <sub>[v1 c9 P12](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0012)</sub>

> You’ll drown yourself or the twins, rowing about the pond in that flat. I’ve lived here for sixty years and I’ve never been on the pond yet.  <sub>[v2 c17 P73](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0073)</sub>
